data.response:
I’d pick **Rossi Idraulica**: €198 cheaper, longer quoted warranty, and old boiler removal included.

| | Rossi | TermoCasa |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Total with VAT | €3,950 | €4,148 |
| Warranty | 10 years with annual servicing | 5 years |
| Timing quoted | Two weeks | Next week |
| Old boiler removal | Included | Unspecified |

The quotes are undated, so availability needs reconfirming. Get Rossi’s warranty terms in writing: [Vaillant’s published programme](https://www.vaillant.it/servizi/garanzia/estensione-garanzia-7-caldaie/) doesn’t independently verify the quoted ten years.
